plan.notes: Source: University of North Florida official Osprey Map (term-by-term sample schedule) for Finance, https://www.unf.edu/catalog/ospreymaps/2025-2026/Finance.html, retrieved 2026-10-09. UNF describes the Osprey Map as a sample schedule (not a contract) to be used with an academic advisor; mile-marker courses should be completed before/by the end of that term. CATALOG YEAR: the map is published under UNF's 2024-2025 Osprey Maps path and the page states 'Effective Term: Fall 2024'; the byte-identical page is also served at the 2025-2026 path (UNF has not published newer maps) — recorded as catalog_year 2024-2025. Terms transcribed as Year N Fall/Spring (UNF labels them Terms 1-8; sequence assumes fall start). Summer advisory tables are suggestions only (catch-up/get-ahead options) and are not sequenced. Credit ranges printed on some rows resolved at the catalog minimum per collection standard; UNF declares Total Program Hours: 120 — sequence sums to 120 at minimum elective credits, and free-elective rows carry UNF's note 'If needed for 120 total hours'. Osprey Maps do not publish per-course enrollment prerequisites; mile markers below are progression milestones (minimum grade C). Mile markers: Term 2: Attempted Hours 16-30: CGS1100 Computer Applications for Business Minimum Grade C | Term 3: Attempted Hours 31-45: MAC2233 Calculus for Business Minimum Grade C | Term 4: Attempted Hours 46-60: ACG2021 Prin of Financial Accounting Minimum Grade C ACG2071 Prin Managerial Accounting Minimum Grade C ECO2013 Principles of Macroeconomics Minimum Grade C ECO2023 Principles of Microeconomics Minimum Grade C STA2023 Statistics for Business Minimum Grade C All Finance Program Prerequisites General Education Requirements | Term 5: Attempted Hours 61-75: FIN3403 Financial Management Minimum Grade C | Term 6: Attempted Hours 76-90: ECO3411 Business/Economic Statistics Minimum Grade C ENC3202 Professional Communication Business FIN4504 Investments Minimum Grade C MAN3025 Principles of Management Minimum Grade C MAR3023 Principles of Marketing Minimum Grade C Civic Literacy Requirement | Term 7: Attempted Hours 91-105: 2.0 Cumulative UNF GPA.
